Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness __equal to or less than__ 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus __greater than__ 10MPa and below 100MPa.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises a silicone.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8).

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has __a thickness that is equal to or less than__ 0.3mm and a Young's modulus __greater than__ 10MPa and below 100MPa; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2).
